notes.title: Patch Note 1.1.0 | New Enemies
notes.content:
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Developer Note[/h3]
I add a developer note panel in the main menu
so I can also announce something there as well as on steam 

[h3]Gold Rebalance[/h3]
Slightly Increases the amount of gold the player gets from killing the enemies

[h3]AI Pathfinding[/h3]
AI Pathfinding will not rebake
this approach may help fix Enemies stop moving 
when the Player completes Building Constructions

[h3]Map[/h3]
Add multiple new map block pattern
[/list]
[h2]Enemies[/h2]
Two new enemies update to the playground
[list]
[h3]Big Boy[/h3]
[*]When Construction or the Player is within attack range
Big Boy will deal damage by stomping the ground

[h3]Jester[/h3]
[*]When the Player is within attack range
Jester will take some time casting a portal at the target position

[*]Portal will teleport the Player to the Starting point of the portal
[/list]

Note from me:
Thank you everyone from around the world
for support of Playground Mayhem, It means a lot to me.

notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.2 | Localization Update
notes.content:
[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Localization Update[/h3]
Adding 2 new languages

[list]
[*] Thai
[*] Russian
[/list]
And more to come...

[h3]Difficulty Rebalance[/h3]
Due to player feedback, 
I have decreased the difficulty of the Normal Wave 
and reduced the starting gold amount.

[h3]AI Pathfinding[/h3]
Slightly change to AI Pathfinding
All enemies will walk a little bit smarter
(Maybe)
[/list]
[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Boom Bot[/h3]
After the Boom bot detects any Player or Construction 
will enter rage mode, increasing movement speed.

[h3]Wander[/h3]
[*] Increases movement speed

[h3]Flashling[/h3]
[*] Slightly increases health
[/list]
[h2]Weapons & Constructions[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Striker[/h3]
[*] Increases damage

[h3]Defender[/h3]
[*] Defender now gains a little height
[*] Greatly Increases damage
[*] Increase range

[h3]Sentinel[/h3]
[*] slightly decreases damage
[*] slightly decreases range
[/list]
